english:
Reloading a Bow consumes an Armor Charge to grant 3 stacks of Godslayer Broadheads.

No Armor Charge can be consumed or stacks granted while the buff is active.

Godslayer Broadheads grant increased stacking damage and 50 Reload Speed with 5% decreased Reload Animation Duration. Firing consumes a stack, and stowing removes all stacks.

Damage bonus against Combatants:
• <primary/>Primary: 35%
• <heavy/>Heavy: 25%

Stacks with everything.
